verses.original: Ἰούδας Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ δοῦλος ἀδελφὸς δὲ Ἰακώβου Τοῖς ἐν Θεῷ Πατρὶ ἠγαπημένοις καὶ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ τετηρημένοις κλητοῖς
verses.transliteration: Ioudas Iēsou Christou doulos adelphos de Iakōbou Tois en Theō Patri ēgapēmenois kai Iēsou Christō tetērēmenois klētois
verses.literal: Jude a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James To those who are called loved by God the Father and kept in Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: JUDAS, servo de Jesus Cristo, e irmão de Tiago, aos chamados, santificados em Deus Pai, e conservados por Jesus Cristo:

verses.original: Ἔλεος ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη καὶ ἀγάπη πληθυνθείη
verses.transliteration: Eleos hymin kai eirēnē kai agapē plēthyntheiē
verses.literal: Mercy peace and love be multiplied to you
verses.literalPt: Misericórdia, e paz, e amor vos sejam multiplicados.

verses.original: Ἀγαπητοί πᾶσαν σπουδὴν ποιούμενος γράφειν ὑμῖν περὶ τῆς κοινῆς ἡμῶν σωτηρίας ἀνάγκην ἔσχον γράψαι ὑμῖν παρακαλῶν ἐπαγωνίζεσθαι τῇ ἅπαξ παραδοθείσῃ τοῖς ἁγίοις πίστει
verses.transliteration: Agapētoi pasan spoudēn poioumenos graphein hymin peri tēs koinēs hēmōn sōtērias anankēn eschon grapsai hymin parakalōn epagōnizesthai tē hapax paradotheisē tois hagiois pistei
verses.literal: Beloved although I made every effort to write to you about the salvation we share I felt it necessary to write and urge you to contend earnestly for the faith entrusted once for all to the saints
verses.literalPt: Amados, procurando eu escrever-vos com toda a diligência acerca da salvação comum, tive por necessidade escrever-vos, e exortar-vos a batalhar pela fé que uma vez foi dada aos santos.

verses.original: παρεισέδυσαν γάρ τινες ἄνθρωποι οἱ πάλαι προγεγραμμένοι εἰς τοῦτο τὸ κρίμα ἀσεβεῖς τὴν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν χάριτα μετατιθέντες εἰς ἀσέλγειαν καὶ τὸν μόνον Δεσπότην καὶ Κύριον ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἀρνούμενοι
verses.transliteration: pareisedysan gar tines anthrōpoi hoi palai progegrammenoi eis touto to krima asebeis tēn tou Theou hēmōn charita metatithentes eis aselgeian kai ton monon Despotēn kai Kyrion hēmōn Iēsoun Christon arnoumenoi
verses.literal: For certain men have crept in among you unnoticed ungodly ones who were designated long ago for - condemnation They turn the grace of our God into a license for immorality and they deny our only Master and Lord Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: Porque se introduziram alguns, que já antes estavam escritos para este mesmo juízo, homens ímpios, que convertem em dissolução a graça de Deus, e negam a Deus, único dominador e Senhor nosso, Jesus Cristo.

verses.original: Ὑπομνῆσαι δὲ ὑμᾶς βούλομαι εἰδότας ὑμᾶς ἅπαξ πάντα ὅτι Ἰησοῦς λαὸν ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου σώσας τὸ δεύτερον τοὺς μὴ πιστεύσαντας ἀπώλεσεν
verses.transliteration: Hypomnēsai de hymas boulomai eidotas hymas hapax panta hoti Iēsous laon ek gēs Aigyptou sōsas to deuteron tous mē pisteusantas apōlesen
verses.literal: Although you are fully aware of this . . . . . . I want to remind you that after . . . Jesus had delivered His people out of the land of Egypt He destroyed those who did not believe
verses.literalPt: Mas quero lembrar-vos, como a quem já uma vez soube isto, que, havendo o Senhor salvo um povo, tirando-o da terra do Egito, destruiu depois os que não creram;

verses.original: ἀγγέλους τε τοὺς μὴ τηρήσαντας τὴν ἑαυτῶν ἀρχὴν ἀλλὰ ἀπολιπόντας τὸ ἴδιον οἰκητήριον εἰς κρίσιν μεγάλης ἡμέρας δεσμοῖς ἀϊδίοις ὑπὸ ζόφον τετήρηκεν
verses.transliteration: angelous te tous mē tērēsantas tēn heautōn archēn alla apolipontas to idion oikētērion eis krisin megalēs hēmeras desmois aidiois hypo zophon tetērēken
verses.literal: And the angels who did not stay within their own domain but abandoned their proper dwelling these He has kept in eternal chains under darkness bound for judgment on that great day
verses.literalPt: E aos anjos que não guardaram o seu principado, mas deixaram a sua própria habitação, reservou na escuridão e em prisões eternas até ao juízo daquele grande dia;

verses.original: ὡς Σόδομα καὶ Γόμορρα καὶ αἱ περὶ αὐτὰς πόλεις τὸν ὅμοιον τρόπον τούτοις ἐκπορνεύσασαι καὶ ἀπελθοῦσαι ὀπίσω σαρκὸς ἑτέρας πρόκεινται δεῖγμα πυρὸς αἰωνίου δίκην ὑπέχουσαι
verses.transliteration: hōs Sodoma kai Gomorra kai hai peri autas poleis ton homoion tropon toutois ekporneusasai kai apelthousai opisō sarkos heteras prokeintai deigma pyros aiōniou dikēn hypechousai
verses.literal: In like manner . . . Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them who indulged in sexual immorality and pursued . . . strange flesh are on display as an example of those who sustain the punishment of eternal fire
verses.literalPt: Assim como Sodoma e Gomorra, e as cidades circunvizinhas, que, havendo-se entregue à fornicação como aqueles, e ido após outra carne, foram postas por exemplo, sofrendo a pena do fogo eterno.

verses.original: Ὁμοίως μέντοι καὶ οὗτοι ἐνυπνιαζόμενοι σάρκα μὲν μιαίνουσιν κυριότητα δὲ ἀθετοῦσιν δόξας δὲ βλασφημοῦσιν
verses.transliteration: Homoiōs mentoi kai houtoi enypniazomenoi sarka men miainousin kyriotēta de athetousin doxas de blasphēmousin
verses.literal: Yet in the same way . . . these dreamers defile their bodies reject authority and slander glorious beings
verses.literalPt: E, contudo, também estes, semelhantemente adormecidos, contaminam a sua carne, e rejeitam a dominação, e vituperam as dignidades.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Μιχαὴλ ὁ ἀρχάγγελος ὅτε τῷ διαβόλῳ διακρινόμενος διελέγετο περὶ τοῦ Μωϋσέως σώματος οὐκ ἐτόλμησεν κρίσιν ἐπενεγκεῖν βλασφημίας ἀλλὰ εἶπεν Ἐπιτιμήσαι σοι Κύριος
verses.transliteration: ho de Michaēl ho archangelos hote tō diabolō diakrinomenos dielegeto peri tou Mōuseōs sōmatos ouk etolmēsen krisin epenenkein blasphēmias alla eipen Epitimēsai soi Kyrios
verses.literal: But even the archangel Michael when he disputed with the devil over the body of Moses did not presume to bring a slanderous charge against him but said The Lord rebuke you
verses.literalPt: Mas o arcanjo Miguel, quando contendia com o diabo, e disputava a respeito do corpo de Moisés, não ousou pronunciar juízo de maldição contra ele; mas disse: O Senhor te repreenda.

verses.original: οὗτοι δὲ ὅσα μὲν οὐκ οἴδασιν βλασφημοῦσιν ὅσα δὲ φυσικῶς ὡς τὰ ἄλογα ζῷα ἐπίστανται ἐν τούτοις φθείρονται
verses.transliteration: houtoi de hosa men ouk oidasin blasphēmousin hosa de physikōs hōs ta aloga zōa epistantai en toutois phtheirontai
verses.literal: These men however - slander what they do not understand and like irrational animals they will be destroyed by the things they do instinctively . . .
verses.literalPt: Estes, porém, dizem mal do que não sabem; e, naquilo que naturalmente conhecem, como animais irracionais se corrompem.

verses.original: οὐαὶ αὐτοῖς ὅτι τῇ ὁδῷ τοῦ Κάϊν ἐπορεύθησαν καὶ τῇ πλάνῃ τοῦ Βαλαὰμ μισθοῦ ἐξεχύθησαν καὶ τῇ ἀντιλογίᾳ τοῦ Κόρε ἀπώλοντο
verses.transliteration: ouai autois hoti tē hodō tou Kain eporeuthēsan kai tē planē tou Balaam misthou exechythēsan kai tē antilogia tou Kore apōlonto
verses.literal: Woe to them They have traveled the path of Cain they have rushed for profit into the error of Balaam they have perished in Korah’s rebellion
verses.literalPt: Ai deles! porque entraram pelo caminho de Caim, e foram levados pelo engano do prêmio de Balaão, e pereceram na contradição de Coré.

verses.original: Οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ ἐν ταῖς ἀγάπαις ὑμῶν σπιλάδες συνευωχούμενοι ἀφόβως ἑαυτοὺς ποιμαίνοντες νεφέλαι ἄνυδροι ὑπὸ ἀνέμων παραφερόμεναι δένδρα φθινοπωρινὰ ἄκαρπα δὶς ἀποθανόντα ἐκριζωθέντα
verses.transliteration: Houtoi eisin hoi en tais agapais hymōn spilades syneuōchoumenoi aphobōs heautous poimainontes nephelai anydroi hypo anemōn parapheromenai dendra phthinopōrina akarpa dis apothanonta ekrizōthenta
verses.literal: These men are hidden reefs in your love feasts shamelessly feasting with you but shepherding only themselves They are clouds without water carried along by the wind fruitless trees in autumn twice dead after being uprooted
verses.literalPt: Estes são manchas em vossas festas de amor, banqueteando-se convosco, e apascentando-se a si mesmos sem temor; são nuvens sem água, levadas pelos ventos de uma para outra parte; são como árvores murchas, infrutíferas, duas vezes mortas, desarraigadas;

verses.original: κύματα ἄγρια θαλάσσης ἐπαφρίζοντα τὰς ἑαυτῶν αἰσχύνας ἀστέρες πλανῆται οἷς ὁ ζόφος τοῦ σκότους εἰς αἰῶνα τετήρηται
verses.transliteration: kymata agria thalassēs epaphrizonta tas heautōn aischynas asteres planētai hois ho zophos tou skotous eis aiōna tetērētai
verses.literal: They are wild waves of the sea foaming up their own shame wandering stars for whom blackest darkness has been reserved forever
verses.literalPt: Ondas impetuosas do mar, que escumam as suas mesmas abominações; estrelas errantes, para os quais está eternamente reservada a negrura das trevas.

verses.original: Προεφήτευσεν δὲ καὶ τούτοις ἕβδομος ἀπὸ Ἀδὰμ Ἑνὼχ λέγων Ἰδοὺ ἦλθεν Κύριος ἐν ἁγίαις μυριάσιν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Proephēteusen de kai toutois hebdomos apo Adam Henōch legōn Idou ēlthen Kyrios en hagiais myriasin autou
verses.literal: Enoch the seventh from Adam also prophesied about them Behold the Lord is coming with myriads of His holy ones
verses.literalPt: E destes profetizou também Enoque, o sétimo depois de Adão, dizendo: Eis que é vindo o Senhor com milhares de seus santos;

verses.original: ποιῆσαι κρίσιν κατὰ πάντων καὶ ἐλέγξαι πάντας τοὺς ἀσεβεῖς περὶ πάντων τῶν ἔργων ἀσεβείας αὐτῶν ὧν ἠσέβησαν καὶ περὶ πάντων τῶν σκληρῶν ὧν ἐλάλησαν κατ’ αὐτοῦ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἀσεβεῖς
verses.transliteration: poiēsai krisin kata pantōn kai elenxai pantas tous asebeis peri pantōn tōn ergōn asebeias autōn hōn ēsebēsan kai peri pantōn tōn sklērōn hōn elalēsan kat’ autou hamartōloi asebeis
verses.literal: to execute judgment on everyone and to convict all the ungodly of every - . . . ungodly act of wickedness and every harsh word spoken against Him by ungodly sinners
verses.literalPt: Para fazer juízo contra todos e condenar dentre eles todos os ímpios, por todas as suas obras de impiedade, que impiamente cometeram, e por todas as duras palavras que ímpios pecadores disseram contra ele.

verses.original: Οὗτοί εἰσιν γογγυσταί μεμψίμοιροι κατὰ τὰς ἐπιθυμίας αὐτῶν πορευόμενοι καὶ τὸ στόμα αὐτῶν λαλεῖ ὑπέρογκα θαυμάζοντες πρόσωπα ὠφελείας χάριν
verses.transliteration: Houtoi eisin gongystai mempsimoiroi kata tas epithymias autōn poreuomenoi kai to stoma autōn lalei hyperonka thaumazontes prosōpa ōpheleias charin
verses.literal: These men are discontented grumblers following after their own lusts their mouths spew arrogance they flatter others for their own advantage
verses.literalPt: Estes são murmuradores, queixosos da sua sorte, andando segundo as suas concupiscências, e cuja boca diz coisas mui arrogantes, admirando as pessoas por causa do interesse.

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς δέ ἀγαπητοί μνήσθητε τῶν ῥημάτων τῶν προειρημένων ὑπὸ τῶν ἀποστόλων τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hymeis de agapētoi mnēsthēte tōn rhēmatōn tōn proeirēmenōn hypo tōn apostolōn tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: But you beloved remember what was foretold by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: Mas vós, amados, lembrai-vos das palavras que vos foram preditas pelos apóstolos de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo;

verses.original: ὅτι ἔλεγον ὑμῖν Ἐπ’ ἐσχάτου τοῦ χρόνου ἔσονται ἐμπαῖκται κατὰ τὰς ἑαυτῶν ἐπιθυμίας πορευόμενοι τῶν ἀσεβειῶν
verses.transliteration: hoti elegon hymin Ep’ eschatou tou chronou esontai empaiktai kata tas heautōn epithymias poreuomenoi tōn asebeiōn
verses.literal: when they said to you In the last times there will be scoffers who will follow after their own ungodly desires
verses.literalPt: Os quais vos diziam que nos últimos tempos haveria escarnecedores que andariam segundo as suas ímpias concupiscências.

verses.original: Οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ ἀποδιορίζοντες ψυχικοί Πνεῦμα μὴ ἔχοντες
verses.transliteration: Houtoi eisin hoi apodiorizontes psychikoi Pneuma mē echontes
verses.literal: These are the ones who cause divisions who are worldly and devoid of the Spirit
verses.literalPt: Estes são os que causam divisões, sensuais, que não têm o Espírito.

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς δέ ἀγαπητοί ἐποικοδομοῦντες ἑαυτοὺς τῇ ἁγιωτάτῃ ὑμῶν πίστει ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ προσευχόμενοι
verses.transliteration: Hymeis de agapētoi epoikodomountes heautous tē hagiōtatē hymōn pistei en Pneumati Hagiō proseuchomenoi
verses.literal: But you beloved by building yourselves up in your most holy faith and praying in the Holy Spirit
verses.literalPt: Mas vós, amados, edificando-vos a vós mesmos sobre a vossa santíssima fé, orando no Espírito Santo,

verses.original: ἑαυτοὺς ἐν ἀγάπῃ Θεοῦ τηρήσατε προσδεχόμενοι τὸ ἔλεος τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον
verses.transliteration: heautous en agapē Theou tērēsate prosdechomenoi to eleos tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou eis zōēn aiōnion
verses.literal: keep yourselves in the love of God as you await the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you eternal life
verses.literalPt: Conservai-vos a vós mesmos no amor de Deus, esperando a misericórdia de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo para a vida eterna.

verses.original: Καὶ οὓς μὲν ἐλεᾶτε διακρινομένους
verses.transliteration: Kai hous men eleate diakrinomenous
verses.literal: And indeed have mercy on those who doubt
verses.literalPt: E apiedai-vos de alguns, usando de discernimento;

verses.original: οὓς δὲ σῴζετε ἐκ πυρὸς ἁρπάζοντες οὓς δὲ ἐλεᾶτε ἐν φόβῳ μισοῦντες καὶ τὸν ἀπὸ τῆς σαρκὸς ἐσπιλωμένον χιτῶνα
verses.transliteration: hous de sōzete ek pyros harpazontes hous de eleate en phobō misountes kai ton apo tēs sarkos espilōmenon chitōna
verses.literal: save others by snatching them from the fire and to still others show mercy tempered with fear hating even the clothing stained by the flesh
verses.literalPt: E salvai alguns com temor, arrebatando-os do fogo, odiando até a túnica manchada da carne.

verses.original: Τῷ δὲ δυναμένῳ φυλάξαι ὑμᾶς ἀπταίστους καὶ στῆσαι κατενώπιον τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ ἀμώμους ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει
verses.transliteration: Tō de dynamenō phylaxai hymas aptaistous kai stēsai katenōpion tēs doxēs autou amōmous en agalliasei
verses.literal: Now to Him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you unblemished in His glorious presence with great joy
verses.literalPt: Ora, àquele que é poderoso para vos guardar de tropeçar, e apresentar-vos irrepreensíveis, com alegria, perante a sua glória,

verses.original: μόνῳ Θεῷ Σωτῆρι ἡμῶν διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν δόξα μεγαλωσύνη κράτος καὶ ἐξουσία πρὸ παντὸς τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ νῦν καὶ εἰς πάντας τοὺς αἰῶνας Ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: monō Theō Sōtēri hēmōn dia Iēsou Christou tou Kyriou hēmōn doxa megalōsynē kratos kai exousia pro pantos tou aiōnos kai nyn kai eis pantas tous aiōnas Amēn
verses.literal: to the only God our Savior be glory majesty dominion and authority through Jesus Christ our Lord before all time and now and for all eternity Amen
verses.literalPt: Ao único Deus sábio, Salvador nosso, seja glória e majestade, domínio e poder, agora, e para todo o sempre. Amém.
